# torch is left unpinned: monai>=1.3 requires torch>=2.8, and the tron drivers
# (595.71.05) handle the CUDA runtime bundled in current wheels.
torch
torchvision

# Core numerics / imaging
# numpy pinned <2: pylidc 0.2.3 predates the numpy 2 ABI break.
numpy<2.0
scipy
scikit-learn
scikit-image
pandas

# Medical imaging
monai>=1.3
torchio
pydicom
SimpleITK
nibabel
# pylidc 0.2.3 uses the SQLAlchemy 1.x declarative API, which 2.0 removed.
sqlalchemy<2.0
pylidc
medmnist

# Models / features
timm

# TCIA download
requests

# Config / tracking / storage
hydra-core
omegaconf
wandb
h5py
tqdm
einops
matplotlib

# pylidc imports pkg_resources at module load; setuptools >=81 removed it.
setuptools<81

pytest
